nodes.name: Fetch website (best-effort)
nodes.notes: Fetch HTML public, 8s timeout, ne plante pas si offline.

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "={{$env.LLM_MODEL_PREMIUM || 'gpt-4o'}}",
  "temperature": 0.1,
  "max_tokens": 1800,
  "response_format": { "type": "json_object" },
  "messages": [
    { "role": "system", "content": "Tu es analyste de prospection senior. Méthode: 1) plan en 3-5 hypothèses, 2) chaque hypothèse cite source_ids parmi snippets fournis (pas d'invention), 3) self-critique + confiance par hypothèse, 4) verdict structuré. Garde-fous: aucune donnée privée, pas de promesses, opt_out détecté -> abandon, conflits explicites, confiance globale <0.55 -> needs_human_research=true. JSON strict sans markdown." },
    { "role": "user", "content": "Prospect:
" + {{ JSON.stringify($json.prospect) }} + "

Signaux site:
" + {{ JSON.stringify($json.website_signals) }} + "

Snippets:
" + {{ JSON.stringify($json.snippets) }} + "

Mémoire pertinente:
" + {{ JSON.stringify($json.memory_hits) }} + "

Patterns historiques niche:
" + {{ JSON.stringify($json.patterns) }} + "

Retourne STRICTEMENT:
{
  "research_plan":["..."],
  "evidence":[{"hypothesis":"...","verdict":"supported|refuted|unknown","source_ids":["..."],"confidence":0.0-1.0,"what_could_invalidate":"..."}],
  "business_summary":"...",
  "website_status":"no_website|likely_outdated|unknown|decent",
  "website_evidence":"...",
  "digital_maturity":{"google_business_present":true|false|null,"https":true|false|null,"responsive_hint":true|false|null,"cms_hint":"..."},
  "opportunity_score":1-10,
  "opportunity_reason":"...",
  "project_difficulty_score":1-10,
  "project_difficulty_label":"simple|medium|complex",
  "suggested_angle":"...",
  "opt_out_signal":true|false,
  "conflicts":["..."],
  "global_confidence":0.0-1.0,
  "next_research_steps":["..."],
  "needs_human_research":true|false,
  "requires_human_validation":true
}" }
  ]
}
